questions.en: How are intent labels, target states, and execution constraints kept consistent?
questions.zh: 意图标签、目标状态和执行约束之间如何保持一致？

questions.en: How does the system detect uncertainty and revise state for unseen intents or changed goals?
questions.zh: 遇到未见意图或目标变更时，系统如何识别不确定性并修正状态？

nodes.title: 意图理解与目标表示 / Intent understanding and goal representation

data.coverage_limits: 只读本项目虚构材料并完成设计；真实中英文献、最近评测和生产分布均未检索。

questions.en: When should an agent ask a clarification question rather than act under uncertainty?
questions.zh: 何时应追问，何时可在不确定条件下行动？

questions.en: How are conflicts and omissions detected when one utterance contains multiple conditionally dependent tasks?
questions.zh: 用户一句话含多个有条件依赖的任务时，如何发现冲突和遗漏？

nodes.title: 多意图、歧义与澄清 / Multiple intents, ambiguity, and clarification

data.coverage_limits: 只读本项目虚构材料并完成设计；真实中英文献、最近评测和生产分布均未检索。

questions.en: Which observable signals predict whether a tool, model, or strategy fits the current task?
questions.zh: 什么可观察信号能预测某种工具、模型或策略适合当前任务？

questions.en: Do routing gains persist under matched budgets and a strong single-model baseline?
questions.zh: 路由收益在相同预算和强单模型基线下是否仍然存在？

nodes.title: 路由、模型选择与策略选择 / Routing, model selection, and strategy selection

questions.en: Does planning fail because of goal representation, state estimation, constraint handling, or execution feedback?
questions.zh: 规划失败来自目标表示、状态估计、约束处理还是执行反馈？

questions.en: What does reflection or search improve after controlling call count, and under which conditions does it worsen performance?
questions.zh: 反思或搜索在控制调用次数后改善了什么，而哪些条件下会恶化？

nodes.title: 规划、反馈与控制 / Planning, feedback, and control

data.coverage_limits: 只读本项目虚构材料并完成设计；真实中英文献、最近评测和生产分布均未检索。

questions.en: When relevant evidence never enters the candidate set, is parsing, chunking, indexing, or querying responsible?
questions.zh: 相关证据未进入候选集合，是解析、切分、索引还是查询造成的？

questions.en: How should retrieval evaluation reflect document additions, version changes, and changing access rights?
questions.zh: 文档新增、版本更新及访问权限变化时，检索评测如何反映真实状态？

nodes.title: 文档摄入、索引与检索 / Document ingestion, indexing, and retrieval

questions.en: After retrieval finds the evidence, which selection or compression operations lose essential conditions?
questions.zh: 检索已召回证据后，哪些选择或压缩操作使关键条件丢失？

questions.en: How can gains from more context be separated from inference cost, conflicting information, and position bias?
questions.zh: 更多上下文带来的收益如何与推理成本、冲突信息及位置偏差区分？

nodes.title: 重排、上下文选择与压缩 / Reranking, context selection, and compression

questions.en: Can gains from an ontology or graph be distinguished from ordinary schema validation and rule-based baselines?
questions.zh: 本体或图结构产生的收益能否与普通模式校验及规则基线区分？

questions.en: How does new or conflicting evidence propagate to entities, relations, inferred results, and provenance?
questions.zh: 新增或冲突证据如何传播到实体、关系、推理结果与来源链？

nodes.title: 知识图谱、本体与结构化知识 / Knowledge graphs, ontologies, and structured knowledge

questions.en: Which errors arise separately from memory writing, reading, updating, and forgetting?
questions.zh: 记忆写入、读取、更新与遗忘各自造成什么错误？

questions.en: Do memory gains transfer across users, time, and tasks without depending on evaluation leakage?
questions.zh: 记忆收益是否能跨用户、时间和任务迁移，而不是依赖评测泄漏？

nodes.title: 记忆、状态与持续适应 / Memory, state, and continual adaptation

questions.en: How can failures be attributed when the tool is correct but arguments, execution order, or result interpretation are wrong?
questions.zh: 工具名称正确但参数、执行顺序或返回值理解错误时，如何定位责任？

questions.en: How can an agent recover from timeouts, partial success, or schema changes without duplicate side effects?
questions.zh: 工具超时、部分成功或模式变更时，怎样恢复并避免重复副作用？

nodes.title: 工具学习、执行与恢复 / Tool learning, execution, and recovery

questions.en: Is every answer claim supported precisely by its linked evidence?
questions.zh: 每条回答断言是否受到相应证据的精确支持？

questions.en: How does the system calibrate conclusions and actions when evidence is missing, conflicting, or stale?
questions.zh: 证据缺失、冲突或过期时，系统如何校准结论强度与行动选择？

nodes.title: 回答生成、事实支持与不确定性 / Answer generation, grounding, and uncertainty

questions.en: Do collaboration gains exceed a single agent or independent sampling under the same total budget?
questions.zh: 协作增益能否超过相同总预算的单智能体或独立采样基线？

questions.en: When do communication, shared memory, and role assignments propagate or reinforce errors?
questions.zh: 通信、共享记忆与角色安排何时造成错误传播或相互强化？

nodes.title: 多智能体协作与人机协作 / Multi-agent and human-agent collaboration

questions.en: Does metric improvement correspond to real task success, or is a proxy being optimized instead?
questions.zh: 指标改善是否对应实际任务成功，是否存在代理指标被优化的问题？

questions.en: Can the experiment rule out budget differences, leakage, judge bias, and random variation as alternative explanations?
questions.zh: 实验能排除预算、数据泄漏、评测器偏差和随机波动等替代解释吗？

nodes.title: 评测、实验设计与科学有效性 / Evaluation, experimental design, and scientific validity

questions.en: How much of an offline gain survives realistic latency, concurrency, budgets, and service failures?
questions.zh: 离线收益在真实延迟、并发、预算和服务故障下能保留多少？

questions.en: Which reproducible system failures reveal a research mechanism that generalizes?
questions.zh: 什么可重现的系统失效揭示了可推广的研究机制？

nodes.title: 生产系统、效率与可靠性 / Production systems, efficiency, and reliability

questions.en: How do untrusted documents, tool outputs, or other agents' messages affect execution authority?
questions.zh: 不可信文档、工具输出或其他智能体信息如何影响执行权限？

questions.en: How can a defense be evaluated jointly for attack success, legitimate-task utility, and added cost?
questions.zh: 防护有效性如何同时测量攻击成功率、正常任务效用与新增成本？
